Reminders about gate queues at the skyport
The desk wrote this for customers
Companion Animal Travel Desk guidance for gate queues

Use this guidance to keep your pet travel plans orderly at the skyport. Aurelia Skyways asks customers to move with care, follow crew direction, and keep carriers secure while waiting near the gate.

If you are traveling with a pet, arrive with documents ready and keep the animal calm in a carrier unless staff give other instructions. The desk welcomes careful preparation because it reduces stress for you, your pet, and the people nearby.

For lounge and pickup arrangements, follow the steps shared at check-in and listen for updates from the service team. <<FACT F001>> Keep your own items together, since crowded queue areas can slow movement and make handoffs less orderly.

When you reach arrival pickup, stay where the staff direct you and do not leave the queue before your name or booking is called. <<FACT F101>> If your pet shows signs of fear or fatigue, tell a crew member at once so the right support can be arranged.

For Port Isolde travelers, review lounge access before you depart and plan ahead for entry with your pet. <<FACT F021>> This helps avoid delays and keeps the process smoother for everyone involved.

The department also shares practical instructions with crews, and the safety coordinator reviews hazards and prevention so pet handling stays controlled and respectful. If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
